name: What is involved in the wood siding replacement process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the wood siding replacement process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with a thorough inspection and estimate. Once agreed, the existing siding is carefully removed, and the underlying sheathing is inspected for any damage or rot that needs repair. New weather-resistant barriers are installed, followed by the chosen wood siding. Finally, the new siding is painted or stained to your specifications. We manage all aspects, from material selection to final clean-up, ensuring a smooth project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspection, old siding removal, structural repairs, weather barrier installation, new siding installation, and finishing.
